caseNameFull: California v. Tenneco Oil Co. Public Utility Commissioner of Oregon v. Phillips Petroleum Co. Northwest Pipeline Corp. v. Phillips Petroleum Co. El Paso Natural Gas Co. v. opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Justice White and Justice Blackmun would grant certiorari. Justice Powell and Justice O’Connor took no part in the *1220consideration or decision of these petitions.
